# F2 schedule windows: check a before day and after day transition hours
def day(sid,dstr):
    d=[(int(t[11:13]),v) for t,v in data[sid] if t[:10]==dstr]
    d.sort(); return d
print("BEFORE 2018-06-11:", day(occ['F2'],'2018-06-11'))
print("AFTER  2018-06-18:", day(occ['F2'],'2018-06-18'))
# F3/F4 active cool setpoints around transition days, occupied band means

    return round(sum(d)/len(d),2)

content.text: The data shows that from mid-June 2018, the occupied-hour cooling setpoint for F2_Z01 dropped by exactly 1 C across every occupied day of the week (24.0→23.0 C on weekdays, 25.7/26.7 unoccupied) — the zone's *scheduled* setpoint series itself shifted as a uniform step, while F3_Z01 and F4_Z01 setpoints stayed at their previous values and no partial/episodic deviation (which would suggest an override or drift due to a controller offset) is visible. This pattern supports a schedule change.
